name: textcraft_global_subagent_rubric_v1
success_gate: The SubAgent must complete the delegated task and return a truthful, usable result to the Parent Agent. If the delegated task is not completed, the final score must be exactly 0.0.
failure_conditions: The delegated task is not completed.
The SubAgent stops, crashes, or loops before completing the delegated task.
The returned result is fabricated or contradicted by the executed actions or final environment state.
The result omits information required for the Parent Agent to use the completed work.

rubric_items.name: Goal Fulfillment
rubric_items.description: Whether the delegated task is completed exactly as requested.
rubric_items.score_0: The requested outcome is absent, incorrect, or incomplete.
rubric_items.score_full: The complete requested outcome is present and matches the delegated task.

rubric_items.name: Correctness and Grounding
rubric_items.description: Whether claims and returned results are supported by executed actions and observed environment states.
rubric_items.score_0: The result is fabricated, unsupported, or contradicted by the trajectory or final state.
rubric_items.score_full: Every material claim and result is directly supported by the trajectory and final state.

rubric_items.name: Utility to Parent
rubric_items.description: Whether the returned result contains the concrete information the Parent Agent needs to continue its task.
rubric_items.score_0: The return is missing, vague, or unusable by the Parent Agent.
rubric_items.score_full: The return clearly communicates the completed result and all decision-relevant facts.

rubric_items.name: Action Validity
rubric_items.description: Whether the SubAgent uses valid actions and avoids harmful operations, invalid resource use, and fabricated execution.
rubric_items.score_0: The trajectory relies on invalid actions, harmful operations, or fabricated execution.
rubric_items.score_full: All consequential actions are valid, grounded, and compatible with the environment constraints.

rubric_items.name: Efficiency
rubric_items.description: Whether the task is completed without unnecessary actions, delegation, or resource consumption.
rubric_items.score_0: The trajectory contains severe avoidable waste, repetition, or irrelevant work.
rubric_items.score_full: The trajectory completes the task directly with no material unnecessary work.

score_anchors.0.0: The delegated task failed. The success gate is not satisfied.
score_anchors.0.25: The delegated task barely succeeded and has major quality problems.
score_anchors.0.5: The delegated task succeeded but has substantial omissions, confusion, or inefficiency.
score_anchors.0.75: The delegated task was completed correctly with only minor problems.
score_anchors.1.0: The delegated task was completed correctly, completely, directly, and efficiently.

scoring_procedure: First evaluate the success gate using only the delegated task, completed trajectory, and final environment state.
If the success gate fails or any failure condition applies, return exactly 0.0.
If the success gate passes, score every rubric item in [0, 1] using its fixed definition.
Compute the weighted sum of the five item scores.
Use the score anchors to calibrate the final score while preserving the weighted ordering.
A successful trajectory must receive a final score greater than 0.0 and at most 1.0.
